shortDescription: Adds IKEA-themed Storageborn genes and abilities, Swedish naming pools, a haulable Flatpack with assembly, and a Blåhaj resurrection serum.
body:
## IKEA Storageborn body genes

Requires and loads after OMW Storageborn Xenotype. Defines six `GeneDef`s extending `OMW_StorageBodyBase`: Blåhaj, Frakta, and FraktaRainbow are in the Industrial Ikea category; Kallax, Billy, and Lack are in the Medieval Ikea category. Each assigns a corresponding childhood backstory, uses matching body texture paths for all body types through a BigAndSmall pawn extension, and gives its defined Storageborn gene package (including optional Alpha Genes entries). FraktaRainbow additionally forces the Gay trait.

## Swedish name RulePackDefs

Defines separate male and female Swedish RulePackDefs, each pairing its gendered first-name file with a shared surname file. First names come from `Docs/Refs/SwedishFirstNames.md`; IKEA product names from `Docs/Refs/IkeaProducts.md` form surnames. These pools are provided for the companion Storageborn Xenotype mod to select based on genes; this mod does not yet assign them to pawns itself.

## Blahaj Blast ability

The Blåhaj body gene grants `OMW_BlahajBlast`, a single-pawn targeted ability with a 300-tick (5-second) cooldown. It plays the custom `OMW_BlahajBlastSound` SoundDef backed by the WAV in `Sounds/Abilities/BlahajBlast.wav`, deals 15 bullet damage, and adds `VU_Hermaphromorph` to a targeted pawn as a xenogene if they do not already have that gene. Its visual runs from caster to target as seven parallel color bands: light blue, light pink, white, white, white, light pink, light blue. Densely spaced, overlapping flecks form the bands into a continuous-looking beam. The SoundDef uses `AudioGrain_Folder` to load from the containing folder, avoiding the asset scanner's `<clipPath>` stub generation.

## RainMaker ability

The FraktaRainbow body gene grants `OMW_RainMaker`. Activating it sets the caster map's current and last weather to vanilla Rain immediately, plays vanilla `Thunder_OffMap` through the camera, and registers a map game condition forcing Rain for 10,000 ticks (four in-game hours). The ability has a 60,000-tick cooldown.

## Flatpack

Adds the `OMW_SB_Flatpack` item labeled “Flatpack,” using a single mod-local IKEA artwork texture via `Graphic_Single`. It is a standalone `ThingWithComps` item—not a resource or a member of a resource category—and remains haulable and single-stack. With a player pawn selected, right-clicking it offers **Assemble Flatpack**; there is no Assemble gizmo. The pawn walks to it and assembles for 3,600 ticks (60 seconds; 300 ticks in Dev Mode), consuming the item and generating a recruitable adult baseliner (18–40 biological years) nearby. The new pawn is generated without gear/apparel and receives one randomly selected xenogene: Kallax, Billy, or Lack. A Debug action, **OMW Storageborn → Spawn 10 OMW_SB_Flatpack**, scatters ten items near the selected pawn or map center.

## Resurrector Blåhaj serum

Adds `OMW_ResurrectorBlahajSerum`, an item copied from the vanilla Resurrector mech serum in market value (1700), stack size, tradeability, reward tag, and use/targeting pattern. Its separate `OMW_ResurrectBlahaj` job preserves the 600-tick handling and resurrection flow but calls the no-side-effects resurrection routine, then adds `OMW_StoragebornBodyIkeaBlahaj` as an endogene to the revived pawn. The item is consumed after the attempt, like vanilla.

## Categories and art

Defines Medieval Ikea and Industrial Ikea Storageborn categories with medieval and industrial world tech levels. Ships north, south, and east body textures for Blåhaj, Billy, Frakta, FraktaRainbow, Kallax, and Lack; gene icons point to the corresponding south-facing textures.
